module_title: The Global Pillars: UN, WHO, WTO, and World Bank
introduction: This foundational block covers the most influential global entities. Questions testing their locations, exact establishment dates, and current chief executives form the absolute core of competitive exams.

core_concepts.title: United Nations (UN)
core_concepts.description:
Headquarters: **New York City, USA** 
Established: **24th October 1945** (Celebrated universally as UN Day). 
Current Leadership: **António Guterres** (Secretary-General). 
Key Mandates: Established by 51 countries post-WWII via the UN Charter to maintain international security, promote human rights, and prevent large-scale conflicts.

core_concepts.title: World Health Organization (WHO)
core_concepts.description:
Headquarters: **Geneva, Switzerland** 
Established: **7th April 1948** (Celebrated annually as World Health Day). 
Current Leadership: **Dr. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus** (Director-General). 
Key Mandates: The UN specialized agency coordinating international public health, managing global disease outbreaks, and drafting healthcare frameworks.

core_concepts.title: World Bank Group (WBG)
core_concepts.description:
Headquarters: **Washington, D.C., USA** 
Established: **July 1944** (Began operations in 1946). 
Current Leadership: **Ajay Banga** (President). 
Key Mandates: Conceived at the historic Bretton Woods Conference. It focuses on reducing extreme poverty by offering low-interest loans, interest-free credits, and grants to developing nations.

core_concepts.title: World Trade Organization (WTO)
core_concepts.description:
Headquarters: **Geneva, Switzerland** 
Established: **1st January 1995** 
Current Leadership: **Dr. Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala** (Director-General). 
Key Mandates: Operates as the apex international body regulating global trade rules and resolving commerce disputes between member states.

important_entities.name: The Bretton Woods Twins
important_entities.significance: A fundamental examiner favorite. The World Bank (IBRD) and the International Monetary Fund (IMF) are collectively designated as the 'Bretton Woods Twins' because both were conceptualized simultaneously during the 1944 Monetary Conference in New Hampshire, USA.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: Exam Trap: Candidates often mistake WHO or WTO for principal organs of the UN. The UN has exactly 6 principal organs (General Assembly, Security Council, Economic and Social Council, Trusteeship Council, International Court of Justice, and Secretariat). Bodies like the WHO are **Specialized Agencies**, whereas the WTO is an independent international organization entirely outside the formal UN organ system.

mnemonics_and_tricks.memory_phrase: All global money is banked in Washington, D.C.
mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: Both the World Bank and the International Monetary Fund (IMF) handle sovereign financial assistance, and both are headquartered in the US capital, Washington, D.C.

exam_strategy_tips: A regular target in high-tier competitive exams: 'Which international organization officially replaced the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT) in 1995?' Answer: World Trade Organization (WTO).
